name: Excalidraw MCP
description: Draws hand-drawn Excalidraw diagrams right in the chat for Claude, ChatGPT, VS Code and other MCP Apps clients, so you can sketch architecture diagrams and edit them.

skills.name: Draw Diagram
skills.description: Renders a hand-drawn diagram from Excalidraw elements with streaming draw-on animations and smooth viewport camera control.

skills.name: Edit Diagrams Fullscreen
skills.description: Opens the diagram in an interactive fullscreen Excalidraw editor so shapes and labels can be adjusted by hand in the chat.

skills.name: Export to excalidraw.com
skills.description: Uploads the diagram to excalidraw.com and returns a shareable URL for viewing or further editing in the browser.

skills.name: Checkpoint and Restore
skills.description: Saves the user-edited diagram as a checkpoint and restores it later, so iterative edits build on the latest version.
